note: One row per logo: {name, slug, group, url, verified, scale, rights?, invert?}. The file is found by convention: site/assets/logos/<slug>.svg, .webp or .png. No file means a clean text tile marked data-confirm=logo-missing. invert marks a white or reversed logo, which gets the dark tile. white marks a logo file with an opaque white background (white tile). scale (default 1) nudges the optical size of one logo so every logo carries the same visual weight. rights marks logos whose brand rules need a check with the client. A tile is a link only when verified is true and url is set. candidateUrl keeps an unverified address so one flag flips it on. Supplier brands are labels, never links. Never redraw a mark. No rating, accreditation or partnership is claimed.
